_note: Condo and townhome communities shown on /carmel-valley-communities/. Names must match the My Maps names. 'page' = this site's community page, if one exists.

areas.n: The northern half of central Carmel Valley, above Del Mar Heights Road. Its condo and townhome communities sit among single-family neighborhoods, a short drive from the Del Mar coast and Torrey Pines.
areas.s: Where most of Carmel Valley's condos and townhomes are. These communities sit below Del Mar Heights Road, close to the shopping, offices and freeway access (I-5 and SR-56) in the center of Carmel Valley, with the widest range of sizes and prices.
areas.cch: A quieter, mostly single-family area in the north-east of Carmel Valley. Only a couple of attached-home communities are here, so listings come up less often than in the central neighborhoods.
areas.phr: The newest part of Carmel Valley, built out from the 2000s onward, and home to Canyon Crest Academy. Its condos and townhomes are newer construction; check each community's Mello-Roos tax along with the HOA fee.
areas.th: South of SR-56, Torrey Hills is close to Sorrento Valley and the I-5/I-805 merge. It has two condo and townhome communities among its single-family neighborhoods.
